title: Business Head - Consumer D2C
description:
Business Head – Consumer D2C Sakthi Super Hub \& CarPod
 





 Location: Coimbatore / Tamil Nadu (travel across South India as needed)    \|    Type: Full\-time    \|    Reports to: Promoter / Group Leadership
 



 Role purpose
 

 Own two early\-stage, founder\-backed consumer businesses and take them from thin websites to real revenue: Sakthi Super Hub (multi\-brand food and wellness D2C that can later become physical retail) and CarPod (premium parked\-vehicle protection pods sold direct to consumer). This is not a coordinator role. It is a builder who lives with the brands, the storefronts, the customer, the unit economics, and the team that does not yet exist.
 



 The two initiatives1\. Sakthi Super Hub — sakthisuperhub.com
 

 Group D2C storefront for existing consumer verticals: Soya Sakthi, Mirakle (mirakle.life), Sakthi Dairy, and VIA Foods. Today the site is a basic shell with Soya Sakthi Prime as the live SKU set. Mandate: make it a working multi\-brand store, then prove a path to physical retail.
 



 2\. CarPod — carpodpro.com
 

 Premium protection for parked cars and bikes: full\-enclosure pods, bubble covers, flood covers. High\-ticket, installation\-led, pan\-India delivery. Mandate: clarify the offer, fix the store, sell, install, and service without damaging brand trust.
 



 What success looks like in the first 12 months
 
 • 
 
 Sakthi Super Hub live as a complete multi\-brand catalogue (not one soya line only), with clean product pages, payments, fulfilment, and repeat\-order mechanics.
 




 • 
 
 Clear monthly D2C GMV, contribution margin, and CAC/LTV for each brand — even if early numbers are small.
 




 • 
 
 Mirakle, dairy, and VIA Foods actually sellable on the Hub, not just listed as tiles.
 




 • 
 
 CarPod offer rewritten so a first\-time visitor understands the product in 10 seconds; size/fit, install, warranty, and after\-sales documented.
 




 • 
 
 A working install\-and\-service playbook for CarPod (South India first), with lead\-to\-install cycle time measured.
 




 • 
 
 A 90\-day physical\-retail test plan for Super Hub (shop\-in\-shop, pop\-up, or exclusive counter) with a go / no\-go recommendation.
 




 • 
 
 A small operating team or agency stack in place so the business does not depend on one person for every order.
 



 ResponsibilitiesP\&L and ownership
 
 • 
 
 Treat Super Hub and CarPod as two P\&Ls under one seat. Weekly numbers: traffic, conversion, AOV, GMV, returns, contribution, cash.
 




 • 
 
 Set 90\-day and 12\-month targets with leadership; flag when a brand should stay D2C\-only vs go physical.
 




 • 
 
 Protect working capital: inventory, packaging, install kits, and dead SKUs.
 



 Brand and offer
 
 • 
 
 Write and hold the simple story for each brand. Super Hub \= trusted group nutrition and wellness in one cart. CarPod \= premium shield for a parked vehicle, not a cheap cover.
 




 • 
 
 Kill placeholder copy, wrong brand names, and leftover template text on both sites.
 




 • 
 
 Define pack architecture, price ladder, bundles, and subscription / refill where it fits (especially soya, Mirakle, dairy).
 




 • 
 
 Own photography, PDPs, FAQs, warranty language, and claims so they stay legally and scientifically honest (especially Mirakle).
 



 Digital commerce
 
 • 
 
 Run both storefronts end to end: catalogue, checkout, payments, logistics partners, COD vs prepaid mix, refunds.
 




 • 
 
 Choose and manage the stack (current sites are basic e\-commerce shells). Upgrade only when it improves conversion or ops, not for decoration.
 




 • 
 
 Performance marketing that can be turned off: Meta, Google, marketplaces (Amazon / 1mg / Healthkart for Mirakle; auto forums and classic\-car groups for CarPod).
 




 • 
 
 Marketplace vs own\-site mix. Own\-site first; marketplaces only with margin discipline.
 



 Operations and customer
 
 • 
 
 Map factory\-to\-door for foods and factory\-to\-install for CarPod. Own SLAs with plants, 3PLs, and install crews.
 




 • 
 
 Build a lightweight CRM / ticket loop. First\-response and install\-quality matter more than vanity ads.
 




 • 
 
 CarPod: site survey, size selection, installation, demo of blower/filter, after\-sales and rodent/flood claims process.
 




 • 
 
 Super Hub: cold\-chain or ambient rules by SKU, expiry, batch, and returns.
 



 Physical path (Super Hub)
 
 • 
 
 Design the first offline format: exclusive counter, shop\-in\-shop, or small format store. Pilot in 1–2 cities before a network idea.
 




 • 
 
 Use group strengths where they help (logistics, existing Sakthi / ABT retail relationships) without dumping wholesale habits onto a D2C brand.
 



 People and vendors
 
 • 
 
 Hire or contract: content, performance media, customer support, CarPod install partners, warehouse pick\-pack.
 




 • 
 
 Be the single internal champion. Factories, finance, legal, and group brands should have one person to call.
 



 Skill set requiredMust have
 
 • 
 **D2C operator, not a brand intern.** 

 Has run or been no. 2 on an own\-site commerce P\&L (foods, wellness, durables, or auto accessories). Knows why contribution margin dies.
 




 • 
 **Offer clarity.** 

 Can rewrite a confused product page into a sentence a customer understands. Comfortable killing bad copy.
 




 • 
 **Full\-funnel digital.** 

 Catalogue, ads, landing pages, WhatsApp / call close, fulfilment. Not ‘I handled Instagram’.
 




 • 
 **Unit economics.** 

 SKU cost, packaging, freight, COD leakage, return rate, install cost. Spreadsheet\-native.
 




 • 
 **Vendor and plant fluency.** 

 Can sit with a soya / dairy / beverage plant or a PVC fabricator and get dates, yields, and defects — without waiting for a coordinator.
 




 • 
 **Customer obsession.** 

 Will answer reviews, watch first 50 orders, and change the pack or install SOP. Not allergic to operations.
 




 • 
 **Bilingual work style.** 

 English for brand and dashboards; Tamil (and ideally Hindi) for plants, installers, and South India customers.
 




 • 
 **Builder temperament.** 

 Comfortable with thin websites, missing SOPs, and no dedicated team on day one. Does not need a 40\-person org to start.
 



 Strongly preferred
 
 • 
 
 FMCG or nutraceutical D2C in India (protein, dairy, beverages, wellness drinks).
 




 • 
 
 High\-consideration home / auto product with installation (covers, water, solar, interiors, EV chargers, aftermarket).
 




 • 
 
 Experience taking a brand from website\-only to first physical touchpoints.
 




 • 
 
 Basic design taste: can brief a designer and reject a messy theme.
 




 • 
 
 Marketplace listing experience (Amazon, Flipkart, 1mg, auto marketplaces) without becoming dependent on them.
 




 • 
 
 Classic\-car / enthusiast community familiarity is a plus for CarPod, not a requirement.
 



 Not a fit
 
 • 
 
 Pure marketing managers who have never owned fulfilment or margin.
 




 • 
 
 Retail merchandisers who only know distributor\-led FMCG and want to ‘appoint stockists’ as the first move.
 




 • 
 
 Agency account leads who need a large brand team behind them.
 




 • 
 
 People who want to redesign logos for six months before the first clean order.
 



 Experience and profile
 
 • 
 
 8–14 years overall; at least 3–5 years in D2C, e\-commerce brand, or consumer founder / no. 2 role.
 




 • 
 
 Has personally shipped a catalogue live and watched weekly orders, not only decks.
 




 • 
 
 Graduate in any discipline; MBA is optional. Proof of building beats pedigree.
 




 • 
 
 Based in or willing to be in Coimbatore / western Tamil Nadu. Frequent plant, warehouse, and customer visits.
 



 How the role is structured
 
 • 
 
 One full\-time seat. Two businesses. Shared playbook: own\-site first, honest product, tight ops.
 




 • 
 
 Time split will flex. Early months: Super Hub catalogue \+ CarPod offer/install clarity in parallel. Do not starve one for a vanity launch of the other.
 




 • 
 
 Authority: day\-to\-day spend within an agreed budget; pricing, listing, creative, and vendor choice. Major capex, factory commitments, and brand\-architecture changes with leadership.
 




 • 
 
 Support from group: product supply from existing plants/brands, logistics relationships, finance, and legal. Not a large dedicated staff on day one.
 



 Compensation
 

 Competitive fixed pay for Coimbatore \+ variable tied to GMV, contribution, and milestone delivery (store completeness, first 1,000 Super Hub orders, first 100 paid CarPod installs — numbers to be set at offer). ESOP / long\-term incentive can be discussed if the person treats this as a multi\-year build.
 



 How to apply
 

 Send a short note (one page, not a 12\-slide deck) covering: (1\) a D2C or consumer business you actually ran, with numbers you can defend; (2\) which of the two initiatives you would fix first in 30 days and why; (3\) current location and notice period.
 





 Title on the offer letter can be Business Head – Consumer D2C, or Head of Brand \& Commerce – Super Hub \& CarPod, depending on the candidate.

description:

For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.
 



**Our Values** 




 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
 


* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.

 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.

* **We Win Together:** 
 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.



 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high\-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company\-level bets on where crypto\-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid\-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.
 



 You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade\-offs, and cross\-functional execution when it matters most.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
* Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
* Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
* Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140\-2\) into a coherent, forward\-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
* Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post\-quantum cryptography (PQC), short\-lived certificates (47\-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
* Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross\-cutting initiatives.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Design on the end\-to\-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
* Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
* Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C\-suite around a shared strategic direction.



 Required Qualifications:
 


* 10\+ years of product management experience, including at least 4\+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
* Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end\-to\-end, from market analysis and vision\-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi\-quarter strategic bets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross\-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
* Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing complex, API\-first products and platform\-level integrations.
* Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.



 Domain Expertise (Preferred):
 



 Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:
 


* Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
* Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST\-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
* Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.



**What’s more in store?** 





 AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health \& wellness policies, saving \& investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L\&D.
 



 What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.
 



**Why AppViewX?** 




 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia.  Snapsy Technologies is a young startup, right out of Registration and Pilot Run. We’re looking for someone who wants to help build Snapsy from scratch.
 



  





 What’s Snapsy All About?
 



  





 Snapsy is an on\-demand platform for local human tasks — basically, if you need something done near you, Snapsy connects you with someone reliable who can handle it. No endless searching, no guesswork, no weird surprises.
 



  





 The Problem We’re Tackling
 



  





 In Bangalore (and honestly, plenty of Indian cities), people face tiny but annoying tasks every day. Finding someone trustworthy to help, at a fair price, is almost impossible.  \- Product: There’s a basic version already running.
 



 \- Traction: Early pilots haven’t started yet. We’re at day zero—which is exactly where builders shine.
 



  





 Building Snapsy Side by Side
 



  





 This isn’t just another job. It’s a chance to start shaping Snapsy from the ground up, right alongside the founder.
 



  





 Who We’re Hoping to Find
 



  





 We want someone who loves building things, likes talking to users, and doesn’t mind figuring stuff out without a rulebook. You should be fine with uncertainty, ready to spend time on the ground in Bangalore (especially for the first 90 days), and be in it for the long haul.

 Equity\-Only, Full Transparency

 What "Success" Means in the First 90 Days
 



  





 Forget scaling for now. If we can get these things repeating smoothly together, we’re winning:
 



  





 Who This Isn’t For
 



  





 Skip this if:
 



 \- You’re after a steady paycheck right now.

 \- You don’t like getting your hands dirty or being on\-ground.

 \- You care more about a fancy title than actually building.
